input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier and operate in any field or territory, and has Vendor acknowledge that we have given no non-compete commitment. That matches the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer). No other provision binds us competitively: § 13.4 contains only ordinary use restrictions (no reverse engineering, no interference), and § 24.2's competitor reference restricts Vendor assignment, which benefits us. The exclusivity language in § 2.2 is a separate commercial term reviewed under the EXCLUSIVITY rule and is not double-flagged here.
